selling_window.note: Hours 6:00 to 21:59, the 16 hours the publisher counts in stock_hour6_22_cnt. Overnight flags are excluded from every availability KPI (see DQ07).

recovery.note: Hourly profile from fully in-stock days, shrunk toward the third-category profile with a prior worth 5 days. Recovered demand = in-stock sales + (1 - coverage) x typical in-stock day; the blend was chosen on the fold-78 masking test. min_coverage only applies to series with no in-stock day in history.
